Overview Text: Private Residence Dormans Park is a 743 m² natural stone package for a country house on the Surrey–Sussex border near East Grinstead. The work is ongoing in 2026 and Marla Stone is currently on site. Ten stones are used across the house: Crema Marfil, Olive Maron, Dover White, Statuario, Arabescato and Calacatta Michelangelo marble, Bianco Carrara CD, Taj Mahal quartzite, Light Beige vein-cut travertine and Jura Beige limestone. The scope runs from a curved marble staircase and the hall and living room floors to fireplaces, kitchen surfaces, bathrooms, WCs, bespoke basins and a basement suite with a bar and an indoor pool.
